content.short: Dedaub provides smart contract audits and blockchain security solutions.
content.description: Dedaub is a Web3 security firm focused on smart contract audits and comprehensive security solutions. Since 2021, the team has completed more than 200 audits, applying advanced tooling and rigorous analysis to safeguard blockchain projects across multiple ecosystems. The group combines seasoned white-hat hackers, PhDs, and technology experts to deliver deep technical insight, risk assessments, and remediation guidance. Their work has earned the trust of prominent industry actors, including the Ethereum Foundation and Chainlink.
